description: Summarize HTTP requests, status codes, timings and response sizes in a browser network export. The report excludes cookies and authorization headers. HAR JSON up to 32 MiB. URLs are reported without query strings; the source may still contain credentials. No recorded request is replayed. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: har_inspect
title: Inspect a HAR file
